files.navigation.css: .navigation{--inset:12px;--icon:18px;--gap:8px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;width:260px;max-width:100%;height:100%;min-height:0;background:#f4f5f7;font:14px system-ui}.nav-content{overflow:auto;min-height:0;flex:1;padding:12px var(--inset)}.navigation h2{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;margin:12px 0 6px;padding-inline:calc(var(--inset) + var(--icon) + var(--gap)) var(--inset)}.navigation ul{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0}.navigation li button{width:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:var(--gap);padding:9px var(--inset);border:0;border-radius:6px;background:transparent;text-align:left;font:inherit;color:#283141}.nav-icon{width:var(--icon);flex:none;text-align:center}.navigation [aria-current=page]{background:#dce6fa;font-weight:600}.navigation button:disabled{color:#69707d;cursor:not-allowed}.nav-unavailable{margin-left:auto;font-size:11px}.workspace-summary{margin-top:20px;border-radius:6px;background:#e5e9f0;padding-block:8px}.workspace-summary h2{margin-top:0}.workspace-summary p{padding-inline:calc(var(--inset) + var(--icon) + var(--gap)) var(--inset);margin:6px 0;font-size:12px}.navigation footer{display:flex;gap:8px;padding:12px var(--inset);border-top:1px solid #d1d6df}.navigation footer button{font:inherit;font-size:12px;background:white;border:1px solid #adb6c6;border-radius:5px;padding:6px 10px}.navigation button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #3863bd;outline-offset:1px}@media(pointer:coarse){.navigation button{min-height:44px}}
